subject: bryn-torie
label: The oak has witnessed all of it
from: The old oak tree, where the vow was made
to: Four events at one tree, and Bryn MOVED it to Ghost Haven
note:
AGES FIVE AND FOUR: Caspar asked Luke whether they would still be friends if he were a girl, and Luke answered almost immediately — of course, you're my best friend, you'd probably have a cool name like TORIE, or VICTORIA if you were a superhero. They promised under that oak to keep finding each other. Ragnar was reassigned out of Fairbrooks the following week.

THE PROPOSAL, with a ring Bryn forged trembling. THE CONSUMMATION, immediately after, against it — and then the rain started and Bryn carried a boneless Torie home to the apartment above the shop. THE VOW, Arc 9. Bryn dug up an oak and hauled it to Ghost Haven so the wedding would happen on the same spot as the naming. The only good memory it has not witnessed is the marriage consummation, which happened in a queen bed Bryn built.
